summary.en: Saegusa's cellphone has a message, saying "Let's meet at the cottage where the hideout of the wanted robber." And Saegusa was terrfied and was shocked about the message. After, while Saegusa was already there. Also, the text message was actually sent to Saegusa by Yamato, who had been hiding this whole time, he never even showed up once, Yamato stunned him, so that he can keep quiet and he wants to sleep any longer. Saegusa's cellphone had a message on it that they will meet at the cottage, and then Saegusa was knocked down by a taser.
